QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_30

question.text: AIFs must compile and disclose their investor-complaints data for each quarter. The compilation-and-disclosure timeline is:

answer.text: Within 30 days from the end of quarter
Within 21 days from the end of quarter
Within 7 days from the end of quarter
Within 60 days from the end of quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5.1 states: 'The data needs to be compiled within 7 days from the end of quarter and disclosed to investors and SEBI.' Quarters end March, June, September and December. AIFs maintain this for the last three financial years. The Trap: Options A, B, D are operationally comfortable but inaccurate. The 7-day rule is aggressive and often missed by understaffed compliance teams. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same 7-day rule. XIX-B tests the distributor-side grievance channel. Manager's Pro-Tip: Automate complaints-dashboard feeds from the registrar and fund administrator so the 7-day compile-and-disclose runs without manual chasing — this is the #1 compliance miss in Cat III ops.
